॥ Om, due to the uniformity of the goal, Om ॥ 1/1/10 ॥

Nor is it stated otherwise in any branch of knowledge, due to the uniformity of the goal. As stated in the Paingisha Upanishad: “All the Vedas, along with their respective practices, are well-established means for attaining the supreme knowledge of Brahman. They all illuminate this, and there is no contradiction among all the Vedas, nor in the Itihasas (epics and histories).” Thus, it is the uniformity of the goal and knowledge that is affirmed. ॥ 10 ॥
